mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bill (billCode, productId, productName, productDesc, productUnit, productCount, totalPrice, isPayment, createdBy, creationDate, providerId, approvalStatus) VALUES (#{billCode}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productDesc}, #{productUnit}, #{productCount}, #{totalPrice}, #{isPayment}, #{createdBy}, #{creationDate}, #{providerId}, #{approvalStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bill SET approvalStatus = #{status}, modifyDate = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
